name: Cross County Center
summary: Cross County Center is Westchester County's premier open-air shopping destination featuring 80+ stores, diverse dining options, and a movie theater in a beautiful outdoor setting. With free parking, seasonal entertainment, and children's play areas, it offers a complete shopping and entertainment experience for the entire family.
demographics: Cross County Center attracts a diverse demographic from Westchester County and the greater Yonkers area, serving middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+. The primary trade area includes young professionals, families with children, and affluent suburban residents who value convenience and outdoor shopping experiences. Visitors typically range from ages 25-65, with a strong representation of dual-income households seeking quality retail, dining, and entertainment options in an accessible location with free parking.
description: Cross County Center stands as Westchester County's premier open-air shopping destination, offering an exceptional retail and dining experience in Yonkers, New York. With over 80 stores spanning fashion, lifestyle, and specialty retail, the center combines the convenience of major chain retailers with the ambiance of a beautifully landscaped outdoor setting. The property features department store anchors alongside popular national brands, complemented by diverse dining options and a full-service Showcase Cinemas movie theater. Families appreciate the seasonal entertainment programming and dedicated children's play areas, while shoppers enjoy the ease of free year-round parking. The center's commitment to sustainability and community engagement, combined with its strategic location at 8000 Mall Walk, makes it a cornerstone of retail activity in the region, drawing visitors from throughout Westchester County and beyond.
